notes.title: Better controller support, bug fixes and lower price
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/ccb2fe336f2ebb7c7fa6ab39ec0791597f95b591.png[/img]

This update is really something you've been waiting for! Today I uploaded a new version v.1.01 which contains the following updates and fixes:

[list]
[*] Better controller support - You can now play the game entirely by controllers. Even menus and options can be handled from your favorite controller
[*] It is now possible to cripple the rocket building factory to give you some extra time to finish all the tasks at hand
[*] Small bug fixes, which didn't impact the game, but was a torn in my eye
[/list]

After much thought I have also lowered the price on this game, to make it accessible to even more people, who enjoys old school arcade action games.

notes.title: DevLog #16: The game is finally finished!
notes.content:
I am really excited to announce that Raid on the Zone is now leaving Early Access! It now has the features and playability I wished for, for the game. It has been bug free for a long while I have gotten good feedback on the game and the process, so I am really happy :-)

To celebrate the full release of the game, it will be dicounted for a limited time. Go grab it today and start killing those pesky enemies

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/ec4e171f2e47eabfdc15deec90888ae6feb4f1aa.gif[/img]

Thank you very much for helping me bring this game to the public! :)

notes.title: DevLog #15: Controllers are now supported
notes.content:
For this update, I have added controller support to the game. Movement controls are right now fixed to the sticks on the controller, but 4 functions can be mapped to a controller button. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/576c17c132d1d2d715af0bdc136276c49e24d71c.png[/img]

I think the game is now in state, that it wont be long before I can release the version 1.00 and take it out of early access. This will be a great day for me :)

It will launch with a discount so more gamers will have a chance to play it.

notes.title: DevLog #14: More additions and tweaking
notes.content:
Development is still going strong and each week I manage to add or tweak a little something in the game. This time I have adjusted the player gun, so it automatically aims for the nearest target within shooting range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/ec4e171f2e47eabfdc15deec90888ae6feb4f1aa.gif[/img]

I have also had time to add/change these things.

[list]
[*] Discovered helipads will now also be shown on the minimap to make it easier to figure out where to fly for refuelling and repairs
[*] Reduced the strength of flying enemies. They are now an easier target
[*] Ingame UI can now be doubled in size, making it easier to read on the big screens. Access it in the pause menu
[/list]

I really like how the development is progressing and I still feel that I'm on track for the final release :-)

notes.title: DevLog #13: Small adjustments to the game
notes.content:
The development is still in progress and this last week I have made the following adjustments to the game:

[b]Player bullet has been buffed[/b]
The player bullet was kind of weak, so I have adjusted its damage and made it a bit faster. It is now also capable of making tiny adjustments in flight for better aiming against enemy targets

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/fc47ef3c8154075ed50743f0e2f25c883a437edc.gif[/img]

[b]Hydra missiles launches at once[/b]
Hydra missiles are no longer being deployed from the player plane. They are launched at once and fly towards the crosshair target on ground

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/5d719349d9526cc80ab8546d4c31727b58e9f923.gif[/img]

[b]More is comming[/b]
I am working on optimizing the game code to avoid lags when large amounts of particles are shown (mainly smoke particles).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/8be7a7821d62391c3ac9bca6c3e1a2b5ce00c6f0.gif[/img]

notes.title: Early access release on friday july 10th, at 10am PDT (5pm GMT)
notes.content:
I very happy to announce that Raid on the Zone will be released into [b]Early Access[/b] on 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png[/img]
[h1]Friday, july 10th at 10am[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/bde6acc9f326e0b9ffacfb24f56b419b84118720.gif[/img]


You will get access to the complete game as it stands today. This means that

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png[/img]
[h3]You can fly around in a beatiful pixel-arty world[/h3]
[i]Your playing field is a large set of islands, and your task is to locate the enemies production facilities in order to destroy them and cripple their ability to produce weapons of mass destruction[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png[/img]
[h3]You will fly the modern twin-propellered versatile helicopter into battle, using turns, breaks and banks[/h3]
[i]You will take control of a state-of-the-art dual-propellered helicoptor as seen in the movie [b]Avatar[/b], which is very durable and easy to control. It is capable of carrying vast amounts of weapons, which helps you in your mission[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png[/img]
[h3]You can take out the enemy with your wast arsenal of deadly weapons[/h3]
[i]Your helicopter is equipped with a Gatling gun, but can be upgraded by buying new and better weapons on the aircraft carrier. These upgrades will be essential in your mission succes.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png[/img]
[h3]You will be challenged by harder and more enemies as you dive deeper into the game[/h3]
[i]In the beginning everything is kinda easy. Like a sleeping bear... But once you awaken your enemy, they will not take it lightly that you destroy their possessions. Rest assured, they WILL come after you. And in great numbers.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png[/img]
[h3]You can complete the game and earn achievements[/h3]
[i]The game is complete gameplay wise. It is possible to beat and complete, but it's by no means easy. You will die a lot! But keep trying. And when you've beat the game, you can always challenge yourself in the [b]Daily Challenge[/b]
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/d7296aef8eaa0d1c975e94887428524abc8d6baa.png[/img]

Development is continuing, to add more enemies, tweaking game difficulty, finding and fixing bugs and to incorporate your ideas and suggestions. You are more than welcome to use the Steam forum or to come and hang out in my Discord server here -> [url=https://discord.gg/zQgwH3x]PetSkull Discord[/url]. I'm always open to a chat about the game and progress on it :)

notes.title: The demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hi,

I've created a first playable demo of my remake of an old arcade classic from the C64 era. It will feature the playing map, the player, a lot of enemies (not all though) and the mechanics.

The demo has no ending and you can play for as long as you like, even though you'll die a lot. You won't get a GAME OVER message.

This IS a demo, and a very early one. So you will probably encounter bugs and things that don't work. I hope you will use the discussions [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1301730/discussions/]linked here[/url] to tell me about your observations.

I also hope you will also take the time to give me feedback on the game. Any and all information is valuable to me, in making this a great game for everyone to enjoy. Thank you :)

notes.title: DevLog #7: Addition of the upgrade shop
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/fcd9f96d7f03316ac055550928aada460002c775.png[/img]

These last couple of days I have been working mainly on improvements, bugfixes and the addition of a shop, where you will be able to buy upgrades for your twin-copter.

When you kill of an enemy asset, you will earny money. Use the money to buy needed upgrades in the shop. 

The following upgrades will be available:

[h3]Hydra rockets[/h3]
[i]These small rockets are pure fire and forget. They will travel on a direct path towards the ground. Objects in their way will get a decent amount of damage.[/i]

[h3]AIM-9 Sidewinder[/h3]
[i]Air-to-air missile which will home in on enemy aircraft within a certain distance[/i]

[h3]Defensive flares[/h3]
[i]Deploy these when you have an enemy missile on your tail. If you have full power and no damage, you will be able to dodge a missile, but if you're damaged it is safer to release some flares[/i]

[h3]Upgraded armour[/h3]
[i]These double kevlar platings will protect your aircraft from all kinds of fire. They will decrease the amount of damage you take when getting hit. Beware though, that the platings will decrease in sufficiency over time[/i]

[h3]Mark MK-82[/h3]
[i]Unguided glide bomb, which will do a lot of damage to all ground structures[/i]

[h3]AGM-65 Maverick[/h3]
[i]Optical guided ground missile, which will home in on any active enemy structure. Do a fair amount of damage to light structures[/i]

[h3]Increased capacity[/h3]
[i]With this hull expansion set, you will be able to carry more weapons on your missions[/i]

[h3]CBU-1 Cluster bomb[/h3]
[i]A mean bomb which will deploy many small unguided glide bomblets, which will do a lot of damage and secondary damage to all structures[/i]


Only the hydra and Mark MK-82 boms will be available in the demo version, which will be released on 9th june at the Steam Game Festival - Summer edition.

notes.title: DevLog #3: Working on object ownership
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/179008eccc39e4e4d72b0e91ba8c988772d92890.png[/img]

From now on, I will update these news pages, with regularly updates on the development of the game. 

Been working on the radars in the game. The radar will try to detect you, from a long distance and will give out two different warnings on your HUD.

[b]TRACK[/b]   
[i]The radar has seen you, but you're out of range[/i]

[b]LOCK[/b]
[i]The radar has a lock on you, and is about to launch a missile[/i]

[b]MISSILE[/b]
[i]You have a missile coming from you. This is where you will deploy your flares and get the hell out of there[/i]

The radar will signal information regarding you, to the AA missile launcher, which will launch a missile, once there's a lock. If you can take out either the radar or the AA launcher, you're safe.

Also, I've adjusted how fast a missile can turn, so you now have a chance of avoiding it, if you're up to speed and turn or bank at the right moment.
